cad: Three watertight, consistently wound, positive-volume connected meshes; print bed Z=0.
three_mf: Four millimetre 3MF documents read by lib3mf without warnings and trimesh; layout has three build items.
slicer: Bambu Studio 02.08.02.61 CLI --info: three objects, each manifold=yes. Import verification only; no G-code or printer settings.

camera_centering.scope: At zero pitch: real PCB shape and stated reference C/CS lens/connector envelopes, excluding mount and motor. This is geometric centring, not mass balance or a guarantee for another lens.

camera_mount.scope: Nominal 1.6mm PCB, 0.5mm washer, 2mm hex nut; plain screw thread envelope, not actual thread engagement, torque, tool-access or PCB component validation.

browser: Light/dark, desktop and 390px phone, keyboard pitch/reset/assembly, theme toggle, rear button state, front/top controls with neutral pose reset, reduced motion and SVG without WebGL. Console clean; controls/readout fit phone; no horizontal overflow.
visual_review: Read assembled, exploded, front/top, light/dark phone, screw withdrawal and rear screenshots; read 4x front/rear assembled/apart close-ups in both themes.
physical: Not printed, assembled or load-tested. Actual PCB thickness/components, fasteners, lens, motors, fit, torque and flexible wiring require first-article verification. Geometric centring applies to the declared reference lens at zero pitch, not centre of mass.
